description:
Served Unfiltered is a podcast created and hosted by Vito Zahariev - an immigrant, a hospitality leader, a storyteller, and a man who has learned to rebuild himself through pressure, responsibility, and grit.

This show was born from a simple idea:
People don’t need another perfect podcast. They need the truth.
The messy truth. The immigrant truth. The leadership truth.
The version of life we don’t post on Instagram.

Every episode opens the door to conversations we usually avoid - identity, growth, fear, confidence, the immigrant journey, and the expectations we carry as adults trying to “figure life out.” With a brain that runs at 100 mph and English as a second language, Vito dives into real stories of self-improvement, culture shock, leadership mistakes, personal breakthroughs, and everything in between.

Here, nothing is rehearsed. Nothing is sugar-coated.
It’s raw, it’s honest, and it’s served unfiltered.

What to expect:

• The immigrant mindset and starting over in a new country
• Leadership in the real world - not the textbook version
• Pressure, burnout, ambition, and finding balance
• How to grow when comfort is the enemy
• Personal stories from Vito’s life, career, and experiences
• Mental battles we don’t talk about enough
• Lessons learned the hard way
• Conversations that feel like sitting at the table with a friend

This podcast is for anyone who’s ever felt behind, overwhelmed, misunderstood, or underestimated… and still wakes up and gives life another chance.

If you’re chasing better, pushing through fear, or building yourself from the ground up - welcome home.
This is your space. 

Episodes dropping weekly. 
Your seat at the table is ready.

SERVING REAL LIFE. REAL STORIES. REAL LESSONS.
Welcome to Served Unfiltered - Life of an Immigrant.

title: Provenance
author: Provenance
description:
Hip-hop history gets told two ways. Either it's a fan retrospective trading on nostalgia, or it's an insider interview show where the guest tells their own version of events. Provenance is neither. It's a researched, sourced, single-narrator documentary podcast that treats hip-hop's history with the same rigor a music historian would bring to jazz or rock and roll.


No guests. No opinions. No beef-baiting. Every episode traces a chain of custody, who actually built what, on top of whose idea, backed by documented sources, not just the version of the story that happened to stick. That includes the flagship names everyone already knows, Wu-Tang Clan, Dr. Dre, Nas, and it includes the founders history has a habit of writing out of the story, the women, the queer artists, the international scenes, and the executives whose names never made it onto the credits despite building the business the whole genre stands on.


Every episode runs 25 minutes and up, released weekly. New episodes every Wednesday.

description:
The Foolishness of Preaching Podcast is a bold exploration of the power of the preached
Word—past, present, and future.

Hosted by Clarence “Passa Jax” Jackson IV, this podcast brings together faith, history, culture, and the Black preaching tradition to uncover the voices, stories, and spiritual legacies that have shaped generations.

From enslaved preachers who proclaimed freedom while living in bondage, to overlooked men
and women whose voices helped sustain Black communities, to today's preachers navigating a rapidly changing world, The Foolishness of Preaching Podcast asks a powerful question: Does preaching still matter?

Through compelling interviews, historical storytelling, biblical reflection, and thought-provoking commentary, Passa Jax examines how preaching has challenged injustice, inspired liberation, built communities, comforted the broken, and given people hope when hope seemed foolish.

Because what the world calls foolishness, God has always had a way of using for His glory.

This is The Foolishness of Preaching Podcast—where there is still power in the preached
Word.

The map is never finished.

Welcome to At the Table, the Food Allergy Podcast brought to you in partnership with Genentech and Novartis. Here we talk food, connection, and living with food allergies.
 
Each episode, we pull up a chair to a different table—from date nights to family dinners to tables abroad—and talk about what it really means to navigate each moment while still eating safely.
 
Hosted by actress and producer Jenna Ushkowitz, mom to a little one with food allergies, and chef and restaurateur Tyler Florence, who as a child was diagnosed with 42 food allergies, the two bring their perspectives to real stories from people living with food allergies—the challenges but also the wins.
 
Because living with food allergies isn’t just about what you can’t eat; it’s about still having your seat at the table.
 
What is XOLAIR?
 
XOLAIR® (omalizumab) for subcutaneous use is an injectable prescription medicine used to treat food allergy in people 1 year of age and older to reduce allergic reactions that may occur after accidentally eating one or more foods to which you are allergic. While taking XOLAIR you should continue to avoid all foods to which you are allergic. It is not known if XOLAIR is safe and effective in people with food allergy under 1 year of age.
 
XOLAIR should not be used for the emergency treatment of any allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis.
 
What is the most important information I should know about XOLAIR?
Severe allergic reaction. A severe allergic reaction called anaphylaxis can happen when you receive XOLAIR. The reaction can occur after the first dose, or after many doses. It may also occur right after a XOLAIR injection or days later. Anaphylaxis is a life-threatening condition and can lead to death. Go to the nearest emergency room right away if you have any of these symptoms of an allergic reaction:
wheezing, shortness of breath, cough, chest tightness, or trouble breathing
low blood pressure, dizziness, fainting, rapid or weak heartbeat, anxiety, or feeling of “impending doom” 
flushing, itching, hives, or feeling warm
swelling of the throat or tongue, throat tightness, hoarse voice, or trouble swallowing
 
Your healthcare provider will monitor you closely for symptoms of an allergic reaction while you are receiving XOLAIR and for a period of time after treatment is initiated. Your healthcare provider should talk to you about getting medical treatment if you have symptoms of an allergic reaction.
Please see the full Prescribing Information for additional safety information, including Boxed Warning, and Medication Guide by visiting bit.ly/XOLPI

The married couple talk about their lives together, their love of food and their 'beefs' with each other.

The Major Roast - a 'real life' look into food, marriage, and more!

title: Revolution 250: Stories From The First Shore
author: WHRO Public Media
description:
The American Revolution offers countless remarkable stories of ordinary citizens doing extraordinary things—from the call for independence in 1776 Philadelphia to the improbable surrender at Yorktown in 1781. Hampton Roads, with its deep harbors and strategic position in the prosperous Virginia colony, played a distinct role in that history.

As America prepares to mark its 250th anniversary, WHRO presents Revolution 250: Stories From The First Shore, a chronicle of America's semi-quincentennial through the people, actions, and events that have shaped our country. This weekly feature offers a fresh and intriguing look at American independence through our region's unique lens.

This podcast is independently produced in recognition of the 250th anniversary of the American Revolution and is not officially affiliated with any national or state Revolution 250 organizations.

title: Finland Mennonite Church Podcast
author: Finland Mennonite Church
description: Welcome to the Finland Mennonite Church Podcast! We are a church family in Pennsburg, Pennsylvania, committed to leading all people into the presence of Jesus. We pursue our vision by gathering to grow, nurturing faith at home, and making disciples as we go. Here you'll find weekly sermons from our Sunday worship gatherings, along with occasional resources to encourage your walk with Christ. Whether you're catching up on a missed message, connected to our church family, or exploring the Christian faith, we pray these messages help you know Jesus!

title: The Shoop

description: Podcast about personal and spiritual development through self awareness.

title: The Maker's Money Podcast
author: Dina Anaya
description: The Maker's Money Podcast is for women running product-based businesses who are tired of feeling busy but broke. Hosted by Dina Anaya — QuickBooks ProAdvisor, longtime custom apparel business owner, and the bookkeeping best friend you wish you'd had — this show unpacks the messy, honest money side of running a creative business. Pricing, profit, bookkeeping, Marketing, and the mindset shifts that turn "just getting by" into a real, profitable business. If you sell on Shopify, Etsy, or TikTok Shop, this is your seat at the money conversation nobody else is having with you. New episodes weekly.

title: Creative Encounters with Isa Lorenzo
author: Isa Lorenzo and Silverlens Gallery
description:
Curious conversations with the people shaping culture.
Creative Encounters is a podcast hosted by gallerist Isa Lorenzo. Through candid conversations with artists, designers, architects, entrepreneurs, and cultural leaders, the series explores the ideas, experiences, and inspirations that shape creative lives. A celebration of Filipino creativity, curiosity, and culture, and the people moving them forward.
Produced by Manila Media in cooperation with Silverlens Gallery.

title: Faithful in Midlife l Realign With God, Less Overwhelm, More Peace, Purpose and Fulfillment
author: Jenny Price
description:
Faithful in Midlife is a podcast for Christian women who want to realign their lives with God and experience less overwhelm and more peace.
If you’re feeling stretched thin, carrying too much, or wondering what God is calling you to in this season, you’re not alone. Each week, you’ll find faith-filled encouragement and practical guidance to help you focus on what matters most, steward this season wisely, and live with greater peace, purpose, and intention.
Together, we’ll explore rooted faith, wise stewardship, and heartfelt hospitality as we learn to walk more closely with God and live faithfully in midlife.
You and me, friend, let’s take the next faithful step together.

title: The Internal Comms Podcast
author: AB Comm
description:
Call it a shift. Call it a revolution. Whatever name you give it, it’s clear internal communications is no longer the poor cousin in the media family tree. At a time when your organisation’s products and services can seemingly be replicated at the touch of a button, the one thing that is hardest to copy – your organisation’s collective wisdom – is fast becoming its most important asset.
In one of the UK’s first internal communications podcasts, Katie Macaulay sits down with IC thought-leaders every other Wednesday to better understand how we can improve communications at work. After all, it’s what’s inside that counts.

title: Change that Sticks
author: Tim Bryant
description: Since 2003, the Lowcountry Biblical Counseling Center has helped people and trained counselors to use God's Word and Spirit to find real hope and lasting change. Change That Sticks brings case-tested biblical counseling into a monthly conversation. Each episode: a tool you can use with anyone, a transforming meditation demonstrated live, and a testimony of a life changed. For counselors, pastors, and anyone carrying a heavy emotion. New episodes monthly. Nothing without Christ. — Tim Bryant, LCBCC | WWW.LCBCC.ORG

title: The Bench 2 Breakthrough Podcast
author: Accelagen Inc
description:
“The Bench 2 Breakthrough Podcast” is the official podcast of Accelagen, created to share real-world insights from the clinical and regulatory front lines of biotech and pharmaceutical development. Hosted by Accelagen founder and CEO Greg Plunkett alongside co-host Rosa Plunkett, the podcast explores global, regional, and local industry news, emerging challenges, and new opportunities shaping the CRO landscape. Each episode blends practical experience with thoughtful discussion, featuring expert guests and perspectives that help sponsors navigate development pathways more efficiently. From early discovery to clinical execution, Bench 2 Breakthrough is about turning scientific progress into meaningful outcomes for patients.

Accelagen is a Melbourne-based, award-winning Contract Research Organisation (CRO) specializing in end-to-end clinical trials, regulatory affairs, and biometrics for pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. Founded in 2010, it supports Phase I-IV trials and offers strategic guidance for drug and medical device development. We believe the future of human health needs a fresh, future-focused approach. We challenge existing conventions to deliver commercially savvy and patient-centric outcomes for leading biopharmaceutical and medical device companies in the fast-growing global trials market across Australia, North America, Asia Pacific, and Europe.

title: A Journey for A Better Tomorrow
author: A Journey For Better Tomorrow
description: A Journey for A Better Tomorrow is a podcast about mental health, real-life struggles, and personal growth. Hosted by Mitch Culbertson, LPC, and Angie Culbertson, MBA, each episode brings honest conversations, meaningful stories, and space to reflect. Whether you're working through stress or simply looking to grow, this podcast offers calm, connection, and clarity — one step at a time.

title: Faith-Led Habits
author: Brittnay Duguay
description:
Do you ever feel like you know what to do... but still struggle to follow through?

Welcome to Faith-Led Habits, the podcast where biblical wisdom meets behavior science.

Hosted by Brittnay Duguay—a board-certified behavior analyst, functional nutritionist, and IFBB Bikini Pro—this podcast is for Christian women who want to live with greater intention in every area of life.

Each week, you'll find honest conversations about faith, health, mindset, habits, personal growth, and the everyday choices that shape who you're becoming. Together, we'll cut through the noise, challenge the lies that keep us stuck, and explore a wiser, more sustainable approach to living well.

If you're ready to steward your health, grow in your faith, and build habits that support the life God is calling you to live, you're in the right place.

title: Terminal

description:
We'll all take a journey through the final TERMINAL.
Here, we refuse to fear death, but look it in the eyes and choose to learn from it. 
Hear stories from:
| Terminally Ill | Near-Death Experiencers | Miraculously Healed |
The TERMINAL mission is to share stories from those who have had their perspective of their earthly life sharpened into focus so that we may learn and live our lives with a more divine & free perspective.

Dr. Michael Longyear is a chiropractor, functional neurologist, co-founder of the Brain Optimization Institute, and an international educator training physicians around the world. After years in clinical practice, he kept hearing the same questions from patients and their families. Questions conventional medicine either didn't have time for or didn't know how to answer.

title: Muslim Money Talk
author: Kestrl

Introducing the Muslim Money Talk Podcast, a place for all things Muslim and Money related.

Every week we'll be sitting down with Founders, leaders and industry experts from across multiple disciplines to discuss lessons learned, mistakes made and most importantly 'How they did it?'.

title: Still Paddling - Stories of Life After Cancer
author: Claudia Espinoza Sobrado
description:
Stories of Life After Cancer is a podcast that shares the inspiring journeys of breast cancer survivors who have found strength, resilience, and purpose beyond diagnosis. 
Hosted by breast cancer survivor and dragon boat teammate Claudia Espinoza, each episode features honest conversations about treatment, recovery, survivorship, prevention and the power of community. Through the unique bond of dragon boating, these women share the lessons, victories, and the hope they’ve gained while navigating life after cancer. 
#LifeAfterCancer #PreventionIsKey

title: Call for Entries
author: Brenden Hubbard
description:
Call for Entries is a podcast exploring the film festival world through the lens of the filmmakers who attend them, the programmers who curate them, and the executive directors who keep them alive. Hosted by filmmaker and AMPAS member Brenden Hubbard, whose producing credits include the Academy Award–winning short Curfew and the feature Before I Disappear, the show offers a firsthand look at the realities of the festival circuit.

Drawing from over a decade of experience developing, producing, and releasing independent films, Hubbard explores the space between submission and screen—where strategy, relationships, and opportunity shape a project’s path. Through conversations with filmmakers, producers, programmers, and industry professionals, Call for Entries examines what actually moves a film forward.

Some guests have found success within the system. Others have questioned it. And some are actively working to reshape it. This isn’t a highlight reel—it’s a conversation about the process. Whether you’re submitting your first film or navigating your next release, Call for Entries is about understanding how this world really works.

Please find more information at bearlytheremedia.com on Twitter and Instagram or contact us directly callforentriespodcast@gmail.com 

Don’t forget to help us out with a like or review!

description:
Getting paid in healthcare is harder than it should be. A doctor sees a patient, does the work, and then has to fight to actually get paid for it. Unreasonably Deep is a show about that fight, and the people going deep enough to fix it.
A podcast from Substrate, the autonomous revenue cycle company, often featuring co-founder Ayo Omojola. Each episode gets past the buzzwords and into how the revenue cycle really works: why claims get denied, where the money leaks, and what AI agents can and cannot do about it. Real operators. Real numbers. Plain language.
The name comes from a simple belief:

title: K-Drama Obsessed Mamas | Beyond “Just One More Episode!”
author: kdramaobsessedmamas
description:
📣 INTRODUCING K-Drama Obsessed Mamas! 🇰🇷
Press play and step into the world of K-Drama Obsessed Mamas — a podcast created by two American besties on opposite coasts with one shared obsession: K-dramas.
From chaebol chaos 👑 to late-night ramyeon cravings 🍜, we dive deep into the unforgettable moments that made us gasp, cry, laugh, or immediately hit rewind. But we go beyond the fangirling to unpacking the emotional twists, cinematic storytelling, cultural layers, iconic characters, and endings that either healed us completely… or absolutely wrecked us.
Join Les and Deb, along with our unofficial language and culture consultant Paul, as we relive and dissect the Korean dramas we cannot stop thinking about. title: Cedar Grove Baptist Church #2
author: Cedar Grove 2
description:
Welcome to the Cedar Grove Baptist Church #2 Bible Study, a weekly podcast dedicated to the study and application of God’s Word.

In a cultural landscape that is constantly shifting, this podcast serves as an anchor, inviting believers and seekers alike to ground their minds in the enduring truth of Scripture.

Our mission is to move past surface-level reflections and dive into the historical context, theological depth, and literary beauty of the Biblical text, equipping you to live with greater spiritual clarity and conviction.

Each week, we will unpack a relevant message, specific passage or biblical theme, breaking down complex theological concepts into clear, actionable insights for your daily life.

Whether you are a ministry leader, a dedicated student of the Bible, or simply looking to deepen your personal study habits, you will find here rigorous, faith-filled teaching designed to sharpen your understanding and transform your walk with Christ.

Thank you for joining us—let us open the Scriptures together.

title: MARKET MINDS
author: Iman Ghaffarifar
description:
MARKET MINDS PODCAST
Market Minds Podcast is where timeless trading wisdom meets modern market psychology.
Welcome to a place where financial markets are studied beyond charts and price movements.
This podcast is dedicated to the timeless principles of trading, investing, market psychology, and the stories behind some of the greatest traders and investors in history. Our goal is not to teach shortcuts or sell trading systems, but to help you develop a deeper understanding of how successful market participants think, learn, and evolve.
In this channel, we explore:
* Trading Psychology and Performance Psychology
* Investing Principles and Wealth Building
* Financial Markets and Market Structure
* Technical Analysis and Price Action
* Risk Management and Decision Making
* Behavioral Finance and Cognitive Biases
* Legendary Trading Books and Financial Literature
* The Life Stories of Great Traders and Investors
* Stock Market, Forex, Gold, Commodities, and Global Markets
* Trading Mindset and Personal Development for Traders
* Timeless Lessons from Market History
You will find narrated and discussed financial classics such as Reminiscences of a Stock Operator , as well as deep dives into influential books on trading, investing, psychology, and human behavior. Each episode combines storytelling, practical market lessons, and personal reflections that can help you become a more disciplined and thoughtful participant in the markets.
Whether you are a beginner or an experienced trader, this channel is designed to help you build something more valuable than a profitable strategy—a profitable mindset.
Keywords: Trading, Investing, Stock Market, Forex, Gold Trading, Financial Markets, Trading Psychology, Investing Psychology, Price Action, Technical Analysis, Market Structure, Risk Management, Jesse Livermore, Warren Buffett, Market Wizards, Behavioral Finance, Financial Books, Trading Books, Investment Books, Trader Mindset, Speculation, Portfolio Management, Personal Finance, Wealth Building, Financial Education, Trading Podcast, Investing Podcast, Financial History, Market Psychology, Financial Freedom.
Learn from the markets. Learn from history. Learn from the minds that shaped them.

title: Between Bedtime & Bills
author: Dom
description:
Between Bedtime & Bills is the podcast you didn't ask for... but probably need.

For everyone trying to juggle real life without dropping the ball (or their sanity), we're talking about everything from those late-night thoughts after the kids are finally asleep to the never-ending bills, relationships, parenting, career chaos, chasing dreams, and wondering what's actually for dinner.

It's a space for honest conversations, relatable stories, laughs, and the occasional "surely it's not just me?" moment. 

No perfect lives. No polished nonsense. Just real people figuring it out one bedtime, one bill, and one cup of coffee at a time.

Still Here is a raw and unfiltered podcast following one man’s fight through lymphoma, brain relapse, chemotherapy, radiation, and CAR T-cell therapy.
From hospital rooms to survival mode, this series shares the physical and emotional reality cancer leaves behind.
No scripts. No sugarcoating. Just honest conversations about fear, family, resilience, and rebuilding life.
This is the story of what it truly means to still be here.

title: The Nomadic Soul
author: Ria
description:
What lights you up is not a distraction. It is the thread.
The Nomadic Soul is a personal essay podcast hosted by Ria — exploring poetry, art, fashion, music, books, and the sacred ordinary. Each episode begins somewhere intimate: a memory, an observation, a question. Then it follows the thread into something larger about how we live and who we're becoming.
This is a show about paying close attention — to a silhouette, a measure of music, a basil leaf sprouting — and discovering what it reveals.
For women who read slowly, look closely, feel deeply, and follow the thread of what lights them up.
Come as you are.

Finance Village is a podcast that caters to both financial professionals and consumers, featuring conversations that challenge and engage experts across the financial industry. It takes a village of experts to ensure the best care for clients, and Finance Village is here to help build that village.

Brain Upgrade is an educational podcast that explores the science of learning, human behavior, psychology, health, technology, and personal growth.

Each episode breaks down complex topics into clear, practical insights you can use in everyday life. From improving memory and focus to understanding the latest discoveries in neuroscience, nutrition, fitness, AI, and productivity, Brain Upgrade helps you make smarter decisions and keep learning throughout your life.

Whether you're a student, professional, entrepreneur, or simply curious about how the world works, Brain Upgrade delivers evidence-based knowledge in an engaging and easy-to-understand format.

Upgrade your mind. Improve your life. One episode at a time.

description: This podcast is about the life setbacks , success, and all the behind the scenes you don’t get to see. I sit with people that matter as they tell their stories to the world. We promise to be as honest and transparent as we can. And we promise to give our absolute best in every single episode we release on this platform.

title: Bedtime Stories with Felix
author: Corina the SLP
description:
Welcome to Bedtime Stories with Felix! As a parent and speech-language pathologist, I've created this podcast to help your family build stronger readers, talkers, and connections—one bedtime story at a time. Each episode pairs a full, uninterrupted story with real family reading moments and practical tips you can use right away to foster development in learning, language, literacy, and love.


What You'll Get:

  • 1–2 simple, actionable tips tied to the story you can try immediately
  • Real (and sometimes messy) family book reading that highlights the tips
  • A complete bedtime story (use chapter markers to skip ahead anytime)


Perfect for parents who believe in the power of bedtime books and better conversations. Spend some time in this podcast as we encourage reading together, asking questions, keeping it real, and engaging in a lot of talking. 


If you enjoyed this podcast, please consider leaving a review or sharing it with friends who love books as much as we do. Your stories matter. If this podcast helped your kids grow, inspired you to read more with them, or if you have a book recommendation that brought your family closer together, I'd love to hear it. Find me on Instagram @CorinaTheSLP to share your bedtime stories or give feedback to help us make this better.

to yourself.

A podcast in short bursts. Each episode poses one question, and two people answer it from where they actually stand.

On each episode, I break down the figures of the film, give cultural context to the time of the movie release, talk about where the actor was in their own career/life, and break down the plot and themes of the film.

title: Well…. Guess What ?
author: Tanice L. McIntosh
description:
If you’re looking to improve yourself while riding solo , welcome to my podcast!!!

I'm an Accredited Grief Therapist, and a Shamanic Practitioner. 

Loss and grief change far more than our emotions and mindset. They can shake our identity, our relationships, our sense of belonging, and of place. They disrupt our understanding of what it means to be alive.

In these podcasts, through the lenses of psychotherapy, spirituality, religion, and sometimes through psychic experience, I explore the deeper questions which loss and grief raise. Questions such as these.  Where do I belong now? Who's here for me? What's it all for anyway? In short, existential questions concerning meaning and purpose when the people we love, when the pets we love, when the places we love and are rooted in, cease to be in our life as before. 

Alone and with invited guests, I pay attention to the profound impact which loss and grief have on our lives. Together, we allow the questions they awaken in us to deepen our understanding of ourselves, of one another, and of what it means to live well with grief.

title: Nose to the Mirror with Abigail Joran
author: Abigail Joran
description:
Blessings and greetings, I am Abigail and I am madly in love with the adventure that is the human emotional experience. On ‘Nose to the Mirror,' we are all about self- honesty and confronting big feelings head- on. We analyze deep,  dense, and complex emotions, and bless them with an unwavering commitment to joy, whimsy, and magic. 


I’m gonna tell it to you straight… despite what society has taught you, you NEED to listen to your heart and believe in your dreams!!! You have one life- apathy and self-suppression is just not an option. Listening to your heart is a basic need- it is urgent and it is important. But how do we really do that in a world like this? That’s the sort of thing we’ll discover together every week on ‘Nose to the Mirror’. 


Emotional suppression is one of the most sinister illnesses infecting our society today. The things we refuse to confront fester inside of us and block us from growing into our most powerful selves. I believe that it is my purpose to combat this through bravery and acceptance. I want to take you with me on a journey of looking deeper and deeper into the cacophony of feelings that we all hold, but don’t fully understand. Together, we will collect hundreds of ways to deepen our commitments to our hearts, in the name of survival and freedom. The human emotional world is an ever-evolving work of abstract art. It is painful, it is exhausting, and it is stunningly mystical and thrilling. The deeper inside you go, the more opportunities you find to feel real life magic.

title: Zero to MVP: How to Turn an Idea into a Product

Most startup podcasts feature founders after they’ve made it. This is the practical podcast that tells the untold story before that!
Zero to MVP, by Tison.io, tells the stories of early-stage founders as they ideate, build and launch their very first MVP. Each episode dives into the spark that started it all, the problem they’re solving, and the unique product they are turning into something real.

description:
*Bible Study with the Homies* is a weekly gathering where Scripture meets real life. This isn’t about religion, denominations, or pretending to have all the answers. It’s about opening the Bible, asking honest questions, challenging each other, and discovering what God’s Word actually says.
Whether you’re new to the Bible, returning to your faith, or have been walking with Christ for years, you’ll find authentic conversations, practical teaching, and a community committed to growing together. Every episode breaks down biblical truth in a way that’s understandable, relevant, and applicable to everyday life, covering relationships, purpose, business, family, culture, spiritual warfare, and living as disciples of Jesus.
Come as you are. Bring your Bible, your questions, and your perspective. Let’s study the Word, sharpen one another, and grow in Christ together.
*Bible Study with the Homies* because faith was never meant to be lived alone.

title: The Safe to Love Again Podcast with Dr. Gary Salyer
author: Dr. Gary Salyer
description:
What if lasting love was never a matter of luck—or of finally finding the one right person—but of how your brain learned the rules of love in the first place?

 

For almost twenty years, Dr. Gary Salyer has helped singles and couples change the patterns that quietly run the show: choosing the wrong people, losing the right ones, and bracing for the moment love turns unsafe. On Safe to Love Again, he brings together attachment theory and the neuroscience of how the brain rewrites itself to explain why we love the way we do—and how those deep rules can change.

 

You'll discover what real love is actually meant to feel like—not as an idea, but in your body, your nervous system, and the relationships you build. And you'll begin to reclaim what was always yours: the power to choose love wisely, create it on purpose, and know how to keep it.

This isn't about trying harder at love. It's about changing what your brain expects love to be, so you can stop repeating the past and finally build something that lasts.

 

Come home to secure love. Learn how to choose it—and keep it.

title: We All Matter with Lisa
author: Weallmatterwithlisa@gmail.com
description: Over the last ten years, I began to notice patterns in my life that left me feeling tired, disconnected, and out of balance. Many came from childhood — they helped me then, but as an adult they kept me stuck. I started searching, not for another way to think about my life, but for a way to live free from those old loops. Along the way, I discovered something important: those patterns weren’t who I was. I was the awareness behind them. This realisation opened space for new ways of relating to myself and others — with clearer boundaries, genuine connection, and a life that feels lighter and more free. We All Matter is where I share what I’ve learned, from simple presence invitations to deeper shifts, so you too can find more space, ease, and possibility in your own life.

Today, we're honoured to share another conversation from The Last Makers a podcast celebrating the people who continue to build, create and manufacture right here in New Zealand.

What followed wasn't just homelessness—it was baboon burglaries, beach parking lots, impossible decisions, survival systems, dark humour, hunger, hope, and the strange logic that only exists when you're trying to make it through one more day.
This isn't a story about hardship. It's a story about two ordinary people navigating circumstances designed to wipe them off the board, finding laughter in the worst place

title: Beyond Should: women reinventing their lives, careers & owning their power
author: Lucy Reynolds
description:
Beyond Should is a podcast about breaking down the barriers of our “shoulds.”

“I should stay in this job… I should take that meeting… I shouldn’t say how I really feel… I should, I should, I should.” Sound familiar?
But what if everything powerful, beautiful, true, and authentic lives on the other side of should?

Hosted by Lucy Reynolds, certified coach and founder of The Murmuration Collective, Beyond Should invites listeners to stop living in their “shoulds” and start naming, claiming, and pursuing what they deeply want. Through stories, wisdom, and candid conversations with inspiring guests — thought leaders, creative minds, advocates, artists, entrepreneurs, and storytellers — each episode explores courage, self-trust, asking for help, embracing failure, and stepping into a more vibrant, authentic way of living.

Expect laughter, honesty, vulnerability, and the occasional f-bomb as we challenge cultural conditioning, shed inherited expectations, and reclaim personal power.

Because when we show up boldly, we elevate not only our own lives — but the world around us.

Beyond Should premieres on Tuesday, March 10th in honor of Women's History Month. New episodes will be out every other Tuesday. 

Follow on Apple Podcast, Spotify, or wherever good podcasts are found. See you on the other side of Should!

author: Brittni Popp & Michael Freeman
description:
The LAYERED Podcast is what happens when a celebrity cake artist marries the guy who never stops giving his opinion.

Hosted by Brittni Popp, founder of the nationally recognized brand Betchin Cakes, and her husband Michael, every episode peels back the layers of marriage, relationships, business, pop culture, internet chaos, and the conversations everyone is thinking—but nobody wants to say out loud.

From celebrity stories and behind-the-scenes moments to hilarious arguments, hot takes, entrepreneurship, friendships, and the occasional overshare, nothing is off-limits. Brittni has spent years building cakes for celebrities, major brands, and unforgettable events, while Michael somehow became an expert on… absolutely everything.

One story. Two completely different versions.

New episodes every week featuring unfiltered conversations, special guests, and plenty of moments that probably should’ve stayed in the group chat.

Welcome to The LAYERED Podcast.

title: Gen X Experience
author: Eric Thompson
description:
Remember when summer lasted forever, Saturday mornings belonged to cartoons, and your bike was your ticket to freedom?

Gen X Experience is the podcast that rewinds the greatest years of our lives—the 1970s and 1980s.

 Hosted by Eric Thompson, each episode explores the music, movies, television, sports, technology, politics, toys, and unforgettable moments that shaped Generation X.From Atari and arcade games to MTV, cassette tapes, VHS rentals, Reagan-era America, blockbuster movies, and the birth of personal computers, we'll revisit the people, events, and cultural milestones that defined a generation. Some episodes celebrate the fun and nostalgia of growing up as latchkey kids, while others examine the major news stories and historic events that influenced our lives.

Whether you spent your weekends at the mall, made mixtapes on your boombox, waited in line for the newest Nintendo game, or remember life before the internet, this podcast is your time machine.New episodes celebrate the memories, history, and experiences that made Generation X one of the most resilient and influential generations ever.

title: The Trophy Bass Podcast
author: Trophy Bass Media
description: Here on The Trophy Bass Podcast we focus on all things Trophy bass. Helping you find new techniques, thought processes, historical information, secret tips, bait modifications, and more. Unlike other shows, we don't tell you that "X bait is best in Y weather conditions in Z colorway". We (and the guest) will tell you what has worked for us in the past, you may need to modify said information for it to work to its full potential on your waters. Every body of water and every fish is different, which becomes even more true when it comes to chasing once in a lifetime sized fish. We hope that you thoroughly enjoy the show and learn something new that you can apply to your fishing! Best of Luck -Trophy Bass Podcast Team

title: Tarot Talks with Edith Mary
author: Edith Mary Stanley
description:
Hello and a warm welcome to Tarot Talks Podcast with Edith Mary, where we take a deep dive into each of the Tarot cards, one by one. We’ll go through the nuances of the symbols, the deeper meanings, card combinations and layouts.  I happily share my 13 years of experience reading and teaching tarot.  


There is a lot to cover and I welcome your input and insights as we travel the path of the tarot. I'll also answer any questions you have texted or emailed me. You can reach me by email, Facebook, Tik Tok & Instagram, all of which can be found on my introduction page. 


Let's have some fun and get started.

title: Lavender Insider Podcast
author: USLGA
description: A podcast dedicated to sharing practical lavender knowledge, inspiring stories, and real-world expertise from lavender growers and industry leaders. Each episode explores farming techniques, distillation, agritourism ideas, member experiences, and educational topics designed to support both current and future lavender enthusiasts. With evergreen conversations and accessible insights, this podcast helps expand visibility and appreciation for the lavender industry—one story at a time.

title: Apply Now: The Higher Ed Marketing Podcast
author: Vital EDU
description: Yesterday’s theories no longer apply in today’s higher education marketing reality. You need practical strategies you can use now — whether you’re up against demographic shifts, rising competition, shrinking budgets, federal student aid decreases, rapidly changing prospective student behaviors, or all of the above. Our hosts from VitalEdu break down everything from innovative paid ad strategies to creative approaches to stopping the scroll and boosting conversions. You’ll come away from each episode with at least one practical change you can implement immediately to drive results, or your money back. Just kidding, it’s free. (And it works.)

title: Dor LeDor: Jewish History and Culture
author: Studio Dor Amsterdam
description: Dor LeDor - meaning "from generation to generation" - traces the extraordinary, unbroken thread of Jewish survival across centuries and continents. Spanning the expanse of global history, the journey examines the towering figures, sacred traditions, and radical ideas that forged a civilization and propelled its heritage across time. As written in Tehillim (Psalms) 145:4, "Generation to generation shall praise Your works." This is Dor LeDor, where the past is not merely remembered, but lives on.

title: Empty Chair Podcast
author: Mickey Trivett
description:
Every empty chair has a story waiting to be told.
Hosted by Mickey Trivett, The Empty Chair is where real people have honest conversations about life, loss, purpose, relationships, anxiety, resilience, faith, business, and everything in between.
No scripts. No performances. No perfect answers.
Just one chair, one story, and one conversation that might change the way you see your own.
Because sometimes the conversation you’ve been avoiding… is the one that changes everything.

title: Trivia for the Ages
author: Ted and Jami
description:
Are you... 

A Boomer who remembers the moon landing?

A Millennial obsessed with the 90s?

A Gen Z master of internet culture?

Anything before, after or in between?


Then team up, bridge that generation gap and use the collective knowledge of everyone in your group!  Each week we present a new, fast-paced episode with a unique theme and 20 questions.  Perfect for family road trips, game nights, or casual listening, everyone has something to contribute!


New episodes drop every Tuesday morning, so hit follow, grab your teammates of all ages, and let's play!

title: The Day One List
author: Jenny McCallum
description:
The Day One List is the podcast about the people you call first.

Every successful career, business, and life is built on relationships. Behind every opportunity is someone who believed in you, challenged you, opened a door, or showed up when it mattered most.


Hosted by Hunter Schwenke with co-host Andru Morgan, each episode features honest conversations with business leaders, entrepreneurs, and community builders as they share the people, decisions, and moments that shaped their journey.


Through recurring segments like The Day One Decision, Hired or Fired, Who’s On Your Day One List?,  and The Day One Challenge, every episode delivers practical leadership insights and relationship lessons listeners can apply immediately.


Because a Day One List isn’t built when you need people it’s built long before you do.


Who’s on your Day One List?

title: The Fertility Fight Club
author: Crystal Leochko
description:
Tired of hearing "everything looks normal" and still not seeing those two pink lines?
Welcome to The Fertility Fight Club - a safe space for women trying to conceive to get real answers, real support, and real hope. I'm Crystal, Holistic Nutritionist and Fertility Coach, and after nine years of my own fertility journey - miscarriages, an ectopic pregnancy, and finally becoming a mom to twins through surrogacy - I know exactly how lonely and confusing this road can feel. This podcast is what I wish I'd had.
Every week, we're covering it all: getting pregnant naturally, IUI, IVF, egg and sperm donation, surrogacy, PCOS, endometriosis, low AMH, unexplained infertility, and everything in between. You'll hear from doctors, embryologists, and fertility experts who'll help you understand what's actually going on in your body - so you can stop Googling at 2am and start moving the needle on your fertility.
We'll also bring you Love Your Story, a series featuring real fertility warriors - women who've been in the trenches, who are still fighting, and who are living proof that you can get to the other side with a baby in your arms.
We’ll also have The Fertility Pulse, your inside look at what’s happening in the fertility world. Crystal and nurse Lindsay share the latest updates, what they’re seeing in practice, and realistic ways you can take action on your fertility journey.  
Then we will have Crystal Clear Fertility, where Crystal breaks down fertility education, new research, treatments, trends, and important updates from the fertility world in a way that actually makes sense. She’ll also share what’s happening behind the scenes at Fertility Blooms, inside the Fertility Fight Club, upcoming events, guest experts, new resources, and the real conversations happening within the community. 
Because this journey is hard enough. You shouldn't have to do it alone. Whether you're just starting to try, deep in the trenches of treatment, or trying again a little later in life, you belong here.
Hit subscribe and let's get you those two positive lines.

title: The Last Person Who Knows
author: Jeremy Nulik
description: Every growing firm has one. The person who holds it in their head, whose absence would stall the whole thing. Usually the owner, and the few they cannot afford to lose. This is a show about that, and about what the business becomes once it no longer runs through them. Honest conversations with owners and leaders of design and build firms. Hosted by Jeremy Nulik, a longtime business journalist.

description:
Roll The Old Bones is a light-hearted Dungeons and Dragons adventure podcast where Duncan (Gen Z, experienced Dungeon Master) teaches Andy (Gen X total newbie) how to play Dungeons & Dragons.
Each week we play a simple one-shot game exploring a scenario in the D&D world. Andy takes on the role of the lead adventurer, exploring different classes of adventurer, while Duncan controls the gameplay and tries to make things challenging.
The play is broken up with comedy skits and sketches including Sidney, the Wandering Monster, Dad Jokes, Items from the Mailbag, and a regular peek into the world of The Dark Lord who has his own roleplaying game, "Bureaucrats & Bosses".
Whether you are a seasoned Dungeons and Dragons Dungeon Master, a casual D&D player, or just a fan of premium improv comedy, sketch comedy, and audio drama absurdism, grab a stool - after checking it's not a Mimic. We're rolling our performance check and bringing you the ultimate D&D comedy experience.
